BiblicalUsage: Nebuchadnezzar comes up in the days of Jehoiakim and makes him his servant, and he comes to Jerusalem and besieges it in the third year of the king. The LORD says He has given all the lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, His servant.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Nebuchadnezzar is the proof that God rules the kings of the earth: the king of Babylon is called God's servant, and he moves only as far as the LORD's hand allows.
